summary: Q32 Bio Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $75 million in common stock through agent Cantor Fitzgerald, replacing a prior $14.2 million ATM program that has been fully used. The filing is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or structural change is involved. The company is no longer subject to Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 volume limits. The stock trades on Nasdaq under QTTB; the agent receives a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds. This is an ordinary equity issuance, not a special situation event.
